description: The host APIs of bits-ui's overlay layers (M6 overlays, docs/design/M6-OVERLAYS.md), compared with Chromium: svelte/events' on() for the document's focusin in the capture and the bubble phase and an element's keydown (with preventDefault), removed through the functions on() returns; tabbable 6.5.0's tabbable, focusable (with the container), isTabbable and isFocusable over hidden, disabled and positive-tabindex elements; a MutationObserver of a container's child list (subtree), notified once per microtask after keyed list updates; document.activeElement, contains, a CustomEvent a function cancels, and a lazily created static singleton holding a WeakMap
